name: phd-noncse-overflow-of-an-unreviewed-candidate
description: Red-team 2026-09-13: F1 (2026-09-12) lets credit the non-CSE allowance refuses still count toward the 60-credit total — but that is about a SETTLED credit, not about an unreviewed §5.2 candidate whose place in the record the DGS has not ruled on yet (2026-09-06: "every graduate course here is a candidate … until the DGS has ruled", and the allocator "never ranks the candidates"). Four unreviewed 3-credit non-CSE transfer courses used to make the total read "12 pending" while the fourth course's own line said "counts only if the DGS picks it".

MATH 60444: counts only if the DGS picks it
